Watershed Stressor Figures

Source: R/getWSStressorFigs.R
getWSStressorFigs.Rd

Get watershed stressor figures

getWSStressorFigs(
  TargetSiteID = TargetSiteID,
  df_WSData = NULL,
  df_WSInfo = NULL,
  df_Sites = NULL,
  comp.reaches = list.CompSites$comp.reaches,
  TargetCOMID = list.CompSites$TargetCOMID,
  useAllCompReaches = useAllCompReaches,
  useBC = FALSE,
  dir_sub = "SiteInfo",
  df_SampSummary = data_sampSummary,
  biocommlist = biocommlist,
  boo_plot = TRUE,
  plotdpi = 600,
  plotH = 6,
  plotW = 8,
  plotunits = "in",
  dir_results
)
